tools.description: Start a new session. Call this when starting work.
tools.name: collab_session_start

tools.description: End session and release all claims.
tools.name: collab_session_end

tools.description:
Unified tool for file/symbol claims. Use action parameter to:
- "create": Declare files you're about to modify
- "check": Check if files are being worked on (ALWAYS call before editing)
- "release": Release a claim when done
- "list": List all active claims

force.description: Force release even if not owner (for release action)

intent.description: What you plan to do (for create action)

tools.name: collab_claim

tools.description: Save or update context to working memory (upsert). Use to persist findings, decisions, or state that should survive context compaction.

category.description: Category: finding, decision, state, todo, important, context

pinned.description: If true, always loaded when recalling active memories.

tools.name: collab_memory_save

tools.description: Recall memories. Use active=true to get pinned + high priority memories for context restoration.

active.description: If true, return pinned + high priority memories only (default behavior for context restoration)

key.description: Get a specific memory by key

tools.name: collab_memory_recall

tools.description: Clear memories. Specify key, category, or clear_all.
tools.name: collab_memory_clear

tools.description:
Unified tool for file protection. Use action parameter to:
- "register": Register a plan or file for protection
- "check": Check if a file is protected before deleting
- "list": List all protected files

type.description: Type of protection (for register). Default: file

tools.name: collab_protect
